svg.aria-label: How do you stop a car being overbooked? It fails: Each request for seats looks fine on its own, so a car can end up with more riders than seats. It catches: At the moment a driver accepts, it counts the seats taken across the whole car, not per group. Limit: Two accepts at the same moment can both pass.
